name: Video Downloader Extension (TDD)
description: Complete implementation of Phases 5-12: FFmpeg Concatenator, Download Manager, Service Worker, Content Script, Popup UI, E2E Tests, Simple Video Support, and Test Coverage Audit.

userStories.title: Implement FFmpeg Concatenator (Fase 5)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement fragment concatenation using FFmpeg.wasm with Web Worker support and progress callbacks, so that downloaded HLS/DASH segments can be combined into a valid MP4 file.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/ffmpeg-concatenator.test.js with 6+ tests covering blob concatenation, TS/M4S support, metadata validation, and error handling
Create __tests__/mocks/ffmpeg.mock.js for FFmpeg.wasm mocking
Create src/utils/ffmpeg-concatenator.js with concatenateFragments(blobs, outputFormat) function
Lazy-load FFmpeg.wasm to minimize memory footprint
Support Web Worker for non-blocking concatenation with AbortSignal support
Implement onProgress callback reporting percentage completion
Cache FFmpeg instance for reuse between calls
All tests pass with coverage >80%
ESLint passes with no warnings
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Consolidates RED/GREEN/REFACTOR phases for FFmpeg module. Depends on existing ffmpeg dependency in package.json.

userStories.title: Implement Download Manager (Fase 6)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement a download manager that integrates with chrome.downloads.download() and generates unique filenames with metadata, so that files are saved correctly to user's downloads folder.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/download-manager.test.js with 7+ tests for blob download, filename generation, sanitization, and conflict detection
Create src/utils/download-manager.js with downloadBlob(blob, filename, options) function
Implement generateFilename(baseUrl, type, quality) returning format: video_20260316_1080p.mp4
Create sanitizeFilename(name) helper using regex to remove invalid characters
Support directory customization via chrome.storage.local with setDownloadDirectory() and getDownloadDirectory()
Add download status tracking: {downloadId, filename, status, progress, timestamp}
Implement resumption support with Range headers for partial downloads
Handle filename conflicts by appending (1), (2), etc.
Support types: 'hls', 'dash', 'simple' with appropriate metadata
All tests pass with coverage >80%
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Consolidates RED/GREEN/REFACTOR phases for Download Manager. Uses chrome.downloads API mocked in tests.

userStories.title: Implement Service Worker (Fase 7)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the Service Worker to intercept network requests and store detected video URLs with deduplication and message-based communication, so the Popup can access detected videos and trigger downloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/service-worker.test.js with 7+ tests for request interception, storage, deduplication, and message handlers
Create src/background/service-worker.js with chrome.webRequest.onBeforeRequest listener
Filter requests by media extension using isMediaURL() from media-extensions.js (already implemented)
Store detected URLs in chrome.storage.local with structure: {url, type, timestamp, tabId}
Implement message handlers: GET_VIDEOS, ADD_VIDEO, CLEAR_VIDEOS, DOWNLOAD_VIDEO
Implement URL deduplication using normalized URLs (ignore query params/fragments)
Add logging with DEBUG_SERVICE_WORKER flag for troubleshooting
Broadcast updates to Popup via chrome.runtime.sendMessage() when videos detected
Integrate with hls-parser, dash-parser, fragment-downloader, ffmpeg-concatenator, download-manager modules
Load and persist videos from storage on initialization
All tests pass with coverage >80%
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CORE functionality. Depends on US-001 (FFmpeg) and US-002 (Download Manager). Uses existing parsers from Phases 1-4.

userStories.title: Implement Content Script (Fase 8)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the Content Script to scan DOM for video elements and send discovered URLs to Service Worker, so that videos missed by network interception are captured.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/content-script.test.js with 7+ tests for DOM scanning, deduplication, MutationObserver, and messaging
Create src/content/content-script.js with findVideoElements() function
Query document.querySelectorAll('video') for direct <video src> and <source> children
Extract src from <video> attributes or nested <source> elements
Implement deduplication of discovered URLs
Send discovered URLs to Service Worker via chrome.runtime.sendMessage({type: 'ADD_VIDEO', url, source: 'dom'})
Setup MutationObserver to detect dynamically added video elements
Support iframes (same-origin) and shadow DOM traversal
Support custom data attributes: data-video-url, data-stream-url
Debounce MutationObserver callbacks to avoid spam
Run findVideoElements() on DOMContentLoaded event
All tests pass with coverage >80%
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-003 (Service Worker). Provides fallback detection when network interception misses videos.

userStories.title: Implement Popup UI (Fase 9)
userStories.description: As a user, I need a popup interface to view detected videos, select quality, and download them with progress tracking, so that I can easily manage video downloads from the extension icon.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/popup.test.js with 8+ tests for video listing, download triggers, progress updates, and UI rendering
Create src/popup/popup.html with video list (ul#video-list), download buttons, clear button, progress bar, status message
Create src/popup/popup.css with responsive styling: list items, buttons, progress bar, color-coded status (green=success, red=error, gray=pending)
Create src/popup/popup.js with getVideoList(), renderVideoList(), downloadVideo() functions
Fetch video list from chrome.storage.local on popup open
Render videos with type icons (📺 HLS, 🎬 DASH, 🎞️ MP4), quality, and file size
Implement download button with type detection (HLS→parser, DASH→parser, simple→fetch)
Display real-time progress bar and status messages during downloads
Implement Clear All button to remove video list
Add filter dropdown: All | HLS | DASH | MP4
Sort videos by recency (detectedAt timestamp) with option to sort by quality
All tests pass with coverage >80%
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: UI story - requires visual verification. Depends on US-003 (Service Worker). Consolidates RED/GREEN/REFACTOR phases.

userStories.title: Implement E2E Integration Tests (Fase 10)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need end-to-end tests validating the complete download pipeline from network detection to file storage, so that all components work correctly together.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/e2e.test.js with 6+ integration tests using Puppeteer
Setup mock HTTP server (localhost:8888) with HLS, DASH, and MP4 test routes
Test complete flow: navigate → detect video → list in popup → download → file saved
Implement separate tests for HLS, DASH, and simple MP4 streams
Validate downloaded file has valid video headers and correct size
Test multiple videos on same page without race conditions
Test parallel downloads (5+ simultaneous) with proper parallelism
Verify no memory leaks during concatenation (profile memory usage)
Performance test: complete download cycle <1 minute for simulated 1GB
All components integrated: Service Worker + Content Script + Popup + download pipeline
All tests pass with coverage >80%
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 through US-005. Validates complete integration before proceeding to edge cases.

userStories.title: Implement Simple Video Download (Fase 11)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to support direct download of simple video formats (MP4, WebM, MOV) without FFmpeg processing, so that non-streaming videos can be downloaded with a simpler path.
acceptanceCriteria: Create __tests__/simple-video-download.test.js with 6+ tests for direct video download, MIME validation, and resumption
Extend src/utils/media-extensions.js with isSimpleVideoURL() function
Add simple video types: 'video-mp4', 'video-webm', 'video-mov', 'video-flv' to MEDIA_EXTENSIONS
Extend src/utils/download-manager.js with downloadSimpleVideo(url, onProgress) function
Implement direct fetch without FFmpeg processing
Support progress reporting via onProgress({current, total, percent})
Implement 3-retry exponential backoff with 30s timeout per attempt
Validate Content-Type header contains 'video/'
Detect server support for Range headers (Accept-Ranges) for resumption
Extend src/popup/popup.js router to detect video type and route to appropriate handler
Same UI/download flow as HLS/DASH but bypassing parser and FFmpeg
All tests pass with coverage >80%
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 (Download Manager). Simplifies download path for non-streaming videos.

userStories.title: Audit Test Coverage (Fase 12.1)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to audit test coverage and add missing tests to reach >80%, so that codebase has adequate test protection.
acceptanceCriteria: Run npm test -- --coverage to generate coverage report
Identify files and branches with coverage <80%
For each gap, identify untested code paths and write tests
Add tests for error cases, edge cases, and boundary conditions
Verify all files reach >80% lines and >75% branches coverage
Generate coverage badge/report for README.md
All tests still pass after coverage improvements
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 through US-007. Audit task to ensure test quality.

userStories.title: Create Testing Documentation (Fase 12.2)
userStories.description: As a developer or contributor, I need clear documentation on running and understanding tests, so that future work can follow established testing patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Create TESTING.md with sections: how to run tests, test structure, fixtures guide, mocks patterns, debugging
Document each test suite: media-extensions, hls-parser, dash-parser, fragment-downloader, ffmpeg-concatenator, download-manager, service-worker, content-script, popup, e2e, simple-video
Explain fixture structure and available test data in __tests__/fixtures/
Explain mock patterns used in __tests__/mocks/chrome-api.js
Provide debugging tips: --verbose, --testNamePattern, node --inspect-brk
Include example test case structure
Update README.md with link to TESTING.md
Verify documentation is clear and complete
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 through US-007. Documentation task for maintainability.

userStories.title: Performance Verification (Fase 12.3)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to measure and optimize build size, startup latency, parser performance, and memory usage, so that the extension meets performance targets.
acceptanceCriteria: Run npm run build and measure output size: service-worker.js, content-script.js, popup.js
Verify FFmpeg.wasm lazy-loads (~30MB separate from main bundles)
Verify total build <100MB
Profile Service Worker startup: should be <500ms
Profile HLS parser: 1000-segment playlist <100ms
Profile DASH parser: complex MPD <200ms
Profile FFmpeg concatenation: peak memory <500MB for large files
Optimize bundle with tree-shaking and minification (webpack already handles production)
Profile extension memory footprint at idle and during download
Document performance metrics in README.md Performance section
All tests still pass after optimization
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-001 through US-007. Performance validation task.

userStories.title: Final Code Polish & Documentation (Fase 12.4)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to polish code quality, ensure consistent naming, verify ESLint compliance, and complete project documentation, so that the codebase is production-ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Run npm run lint and verify zero ESLint violations and zero warnings
Verify all filenames are descriptive: hls-parser.js (not parser.js), ffmpeg-concatenator.js (not concat.js)
Verify all function names are descriptive: parseHLS(), parseDALE(), downloadFragments(), etc.
Verify variable names are descriptive: mediaUrl, fragmentBlobs, downloadProgress (not url, blobs, progress)
Review comments: explain 'why' not 'what', remove obvious comments, keep only high-value explanations
Update README.md with: setup instructions, test commands, architecture overview (3 components), tech stack, performance benchmarks, known limitations
Verify all console.log and debug code is removed or gated behind DEBUG flags
Final commit: 'docs(project): final polish and documentation'
All tests still pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Final task. Consolidates polish phase. Depends on US-001 through US-010.
